cohort: 416 mothers who gave birth within the last six months in Debre Berhan town, Ethiopia
finding: The study found that timely initiation of breastfeeding was associated with higher monthly income, nuclear family structure, receiving antenatal breastfeeding counseling, vaginal delivery, and delivery assisted by a healthcare professional.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was negatively associated with timely initiation of breastfeeding.
